Map a legacy query id to its analysis-catalog entry name

Source: R/queries.R
dot-query_id_to_name.Rd

QueryLibrary templates are registered in the unified catalog under the pack-prefixed name "dsomop:<query_id>". This prefixes a bare legacy query_id (and leaves an already-prefixed name untouched).

Usage

.query_id_to_name(query_id)

Arguments

query_id

Character; a legacy query id or an already-prefixed name.

Value

Character; the catalog entry name.
